title: ai settings / Agent sessions
content:
## Agent sessions Use the [session lists](/docs/agents/run/sessions/manage-sessions.md#sessions-list) to manage local and remote agent sessions, switch between tasks, and track their progress. ### Session experience | Setting and Description | Default | |------------------------|---------------| | `setting(workbench.startupEditor)`
Set to `agentSessionsWelcomePage` to show the [sessions welcome page](/docs/agents/run/chat-view.md#view-sessions-on-the-welcome-page) with recent sessions, embedded chat, and quick actions when no editors are restored. | `"welcomePage"` | | `setting(chat.viewSessions.enabled)`
Show the agent sessions list in the {% data variables.copilot.chat_view %}. | `true` | | `setting(chat.viewSessions.orientation)`
Control the layout orientation of the sessions list in the {% data variables.copilot.chat_view %}. | `"sideBySide"` | | `setting(chat.agentSessions.showExternal)` _(Experimental)_
Control which [sessions from supported external applications](/docs/agents/run/sessions/manage-sessions.md#view-sessions-from-other-applications) appear in the session lists. Values are `none`, `recent`, `last24Hours`, `last7Days`, and `last30Days`. Discovery limits still apply. | `"last7Days"` | | `setting(chat.agentSessions.sessionStorageCleanupSuggestion.enabled)` _(Experimental)_
Show a suggestion to [clean up inactive session worktrees](/docs/agents/run/sessions/manage-sessions.md#clean-up-session-worktrees) when they use at least 5 GiB or 20 worktrees are eligible for cleanup. | `false` | | `setting(chat.agentSessions.autoMarkAsDoneMergedSessionsAfterDays)` `feature(automatic-session-cleanup)`
Control the number of inactive days before an eligible session with a merged pull request is [automatically marked as done](/docs/agents/run/sessions/manage-sessions.md#automatically-clean-up-merged-sessions). Set to `0` to disable automatic cleanup. The recommended value is `15`. | `0` | | `setting(chat.agentSessions.autoDeleteMarkedAsDoneMergedSessionsAfterDays)` `feature(automatic-session-cleanup)`
Control the number of days after an eligible session is automatically marked as done before it is permanently deleted. Sessions that you mark as done manually aren't deleted automatically. Set to `0` to disable permanent deletion. The recommended value is `15`. | `0` | | `setting(sessions.showChatTabs)` _(Preview)_
Show each chat as a tab with `multiple`, or show only the active chat as the session view with `single`. | `"multiple"` | | `setting(sessions.chat.compareAgents.enabled)` _(Preview)_
Enable [model comparison](/docs/agents/run/compare-models.md) for eligible new sessions in the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %}. Run the same prompt with multiple models in independent chats or isolated worktrees. | `true` | | `setting(sessions.chat.unifiedWorkspacePicker.enabled)`
Use the unified workspace picker in the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %} to search local, GitHub, and remote workspaces and, when supported, start a session without a workspace. | `true` | | `setting(sessions.chat.experimental.newSessionComposerLayout)` _(Experimental)_
Group workspace, repository, worktree, and harness controls above the new-session input. Requires the unified workspace picker. | `true` (Insiders)
`false` (Stable) | | `setting(sessions.chat.experimental.environmentPicker)`
Show a separate Environment picker for new sessions in the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %}. Requires the unified workspace picker and experimental new-session composer layout. When off, environment choices remain in the workspace and harness pickers. | `true` | | `setting(sessions.chat.experimental.environmentPickerManageRemotes)` _(Experimental)_
Enable [remote environment management](/docs/agents/run/remote-agent-sessions.md#manage-remote-environments-experimental) and its picker visibility preferences. Requires the Environment picker and `setting(chat.remoteAgentHostsEnabled)`. Turning this off ignores saved visibility preferences without deleting them. | `true` | | `setting(sessions.chat.experimental.welcomePhrases)` _(Experimental)_
Show rotating welcome phrases above the new-session composer in the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %}. | `false` | | `setting(sessions.chat.experimental.welcomeName)` _(Experimental)_
Set the name in new-session welcome messages. Leave empty to use the first name from the signed-in GitHub profile when available. | `""` | | `setting(sessions.chat.experimental.welcomeMessages)` _(Experimental)_
Add custom welcome phrases to the defaults with `append`, or use only custom phrases with `replace`. Use `{name}` to position the welcome name in a phrase. | `{"mode": "append", "phrases": []}` | | `setting(chat.editMode.hidden)`
Restore the deprecated Edit mode for multi-file code edits. | `true` | | `setting(chat.agentsControl.enabled)` _(Experimental)_
Enable the [session status indicator](/docs/agents/run/chat-view.md#session-status-indicator-experimental) in the command center. Shows unread and in-progress session badges. | `true` | | `setting(chat.agentsControl.clickBehavior)` _(Experimental)_
Configure the behavior when selecting the chat icon in the agent status indicator. | `"cycle"` (Insiders)
`"default"` (Stable) | | `setting(sessions.showApplicationBadge)` _(Preview)_
Show the number of unarchived sessions that need attention on the [application icon](/docs/agents/run/agents-window-configuration.md#monitor-sessions-from-the-application-icon-preview). | `true` (Insiders)
`false` (Stable) | | `setting(chat.agentSessions.appearanceTools.enabled)`
Enable the agent tools and built-in skill for [generating and setting chat backgrounds](/docs/chat/chat-overview.md#generate-a-chat-background-experimental) in the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %}. Disabling the setting doesn't remove existing backgrounds or affect manual background controls. | `true` | | `setting(chat.agentSessions.preferredDarkBackgroundImageLayout)` _(Experimental)_
Control the [chat background image layout](/docs/chat/chat-overview.md#customize-the-agents-window-chat-background) in the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %} when using a dark color theme. | `"repeat"` | | `setting(chat.agentSessions.preferredLightBackgroundImageLayout)` _(Experimental)_
Control the [chat background image layout](/docs/chat/chat-overview.md#customize-the-agents-window-chat-background) in the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %} when using a light color theme. | `"repeat"` | | `setting(chat.unifiedAgentsBar.enabled)` _(Experimental)_
Replace the command center search box with a unified chat and search control. | `false` | | `setting(sessions.layout.singlePaneDetailPanel)` _(Experimental)_
Dock the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %} detail panel inside the editor with a shared tab bar. Requires a window reload to take effect. | `false` | | `setting(sessions.editor.wordWrap)` _(Experimental)_
Control [how code editors in the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %} wrap long lines](/docs/agents/run/agents-window-configuration.md#configure-word-wrap-for-code-editors). Values are `off`, `on`, and `inherit`. | `"inherit"` | | `setting(sessions.diffEditor.wordWrap)` _(Experimental)_
Control [how diff editors in the **Changes** view wrap long lines](/docs/agents/run/review-code-edits.md#configure-word-wrap-in-diff-editors). Values are `off`, `on`, and `inherit`. | `"inherit"` | | `setting(chat.experimental.agentsWindowPRComments)` `feature(agents-window-pr-comments)`
Show **Add PR Comment** when you [add range comments while reviewing agent changes](/docs/agents/run/review-code-edits.md#add-pull-request-review-comments). | `false` | | `setting(sessions.useWorktree)` _(Insiders)_
Control whether **New Worktree** is selected when no previous code-isolation choice has been saved. After you start a session, the saved choice applies across workspaces instead. | `true` | | `setting(chat.automations.enabled)`
Show [Automations](/docs/agents/run/automations.md) in the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %} and dispatch local scheduled tasks. Turning this off hides entry points and stops local dispatch, not active triggers on GitHub. | `true` | | `setting(chat.automations.cloud.enabled)` `feature(cloud-automations)`
Manage [cloud automations](/docs/agents/run/automations.md#create-an-automation) in eligible private GitHub repositories. Turning this off hides cloud controls but doesn't stop existing GitHub schedules or event triggers. | `true` | | `setting(chat.agentHost.remoteConnections)` _(Preview)_
Choose the method for [sharing this machine](/docs/agents/run/remote-agent-sessions.md#register-your-machine): `devTunnel` or `githubEnvironment`. Selecting a method in **Remote Connections** starts sharing. **Off** stops sharing without changing the preference. Editing this setting directly stops sharing. | `"devTunnel"` | | `setting(chat.agentHost.githubEnvironments.enabled)` _(Preview)_
Allow sharing this machine as a [GitHub Environment](/docs/agents/run/remote-agent-sessions.md#github-environments-preview), and discovering and connecting to other registered machines. Subject to rollout and organization policy. | `true` | | `setting(chat.remoteAgentHostsAutoConnect)` _(Experimental)_
Automatically connect to eligible remote hosts. For [GitHub Environments](/docs/agents/run/remote-agent-sessions.md#connect-from-another-client) on desktop, first connect explicitly. Reconnection is scoped to the profile and account. Explicit disconnect suppresses it until you connect manually. | `true` | | `setting(github.copilot.chat.localIndex.enabled)`
Enable local session tracking for [session insights](/docs/agents/run/sessions/session-history.md#query-session-history-with-chronicle) and `/chronicle` commands. | `true` | | `setting(chat.sessionSync.enabled)` _(Experimental)_
Sync [session history](/docs/agents/run/sessions/session-history.md#enable-or-disable-session-sync-experimental) to GitHub.com for cross-device access. Requires `setting(github.copilot.chat.localIndex.enabled)`. Set a preference explicitly and check the [sync status](/docs/agents/run/sessions/session-history.md#session-sync-status). | `false` | | `setting(chat.sessionSync.excludeRepositories)` _(Experimental)_
Repository patterns to exclude from [session sync](/docs/agents/run/sessions/session-history.md#exclude-repositories-from-sync). Use exact `owner/repo` names or glob patterns like `my-org/*`. Matching sessions are not uploaded by session sync. | `[]` | ### Agent Host | Setting and Description | Default | |------------------------|---------------| | `setting(chat.agentHost.allowSignedOutWhenUsable)` _(Experimental)_
Open the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %} without GitHub authentication when at least one registered session type can run with its own provider credentials. Providers, models, and operations that require GitHub authentication prompt you to sign in when needed. | `false` | | `setting(chat.agentHost.byokModels.enabled)` `feature(agent-host-byok-models)`
Make extension-provided [BYOK](/docs/agent-customization/language-models.md#bring-your-own-language-model-key) models available to the Agent Host. Changes are synchronized to the running process. | `false` | | `setting(chat.copilot.memory.enabled)`
Use cloud-backed [{% data variables.copilot.copilot_memory %}](/docs/agents/run/memory.md#copilot-memory) to store and recall repository facts and user preferences in local {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} sessions. {% data variables.product.prodname_github %} account settings and organization policies still apply. Changes apply to sessions created or resumed after the setting changes. | `true` | | `setting(chat.agentHost.claudeAgent.enabled)` _(Experimental)_
Make the Claude provider available to the [Agent Host](/docs/agents/concepts/agent-host.md), unless [enterprise-managed settings disable it](/docs/enterprise/manage-ai-settings.md#claude-and-codex-availability). Restart the Agent Host process for the change to take effect. | `true` | | `setting(chat.agentHost.codexAgent.enabled)` _(Experimental)_
Make the Codex provider available to the [Agent Host](/docs/agents/concepts/agent-host.md), unless [enterprise-managed settings disable it](/docs/enterprise/manage-ai-settings.md#claude-and-codex-availability). Enabling takes effect without a restart. Disabling takes effect after the next Agent Host restart. | `false` | | `setting(chat.agentHost.computerUse.enabled)` _(Experimental)_
Offer [Computer Use](/docs/agents/run/tools.md#control-desktop-applications-experimental) in local {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} sessions on macOS and Windows to interact with desktop applications. The plugin downloads on first use and requires activation and application approvals. Restart {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} after changing this setting. | `false` | | `setting(chat.copilot.localModel.enabled)` `feature(on-device-models)`
Offer [on-device models](/docs/agent-customization/language-models.md#use-on-device-models-experimental) to download and run on this device with llama.cpp. Changes restart the local Copilot runtime after active turns finish. | `false` | | `setting(chat.copilot.localModel.useInAuto)` `feature(on-device-models)`
Enable Auto to route turns to the active on-device model, with cloud fallback. Changes take effect immediately. | `false` | | `setting(chat.copilot.localModel.llamaServerPath)` `feature(on-device-models)`
Specify the absolute path to a user-installed `llama-server` executable. {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} doesn't install llama.cpp. | `""` | | `setting(chat.agentHost.devContainer.enabled)`
Show **Use Dev Container** for eligible local folders and folders on SSH, Tunnel, or WSL hosts, and [run sessions in the project's Dev Container](/docs/agents/run/agents-window.md#run-a-session-in-a-dev-container). | `true` | | `setting(chat.agentHost.cloudSandbox.enabled)` `feature(cloud-sessions)`
Create and discover [cloud sessions](/docs/agents/run/cloud-sandbox-sessions.md). In the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %}, use cloud sessions instead of the {% data variables.copilot.copilot_cloud_agent %} workflow on {% data variables.product.prodname_github %} Actions for new **Cloud** sessions. Requires `setting(chat.remoteAgentHostsEnabled)` and service access. | `false` | | `setting(chat.agentHost.cloudSandbox.autoConnectOnOpen)` `feature(cloud-sessions)`
Connect to or wake a cloud environment when opening or restoring its chat in the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %}. Turn off to wait until you start composing or explicitly connect. | `true` | | `setting(chat.agentHost.cloudSandbox.earlyPreparation)` `feature(cloud-sessions)`
Prepare an eligible cloud environment while composing a new Cloud chat. This can allocate compute before the prompt is sent. | `false` | | `setting(chat.agentHost.agentOrchestrationLimits)` _(Experimental)_
Control [per-session creation and messaging limits](/docs/agents/run/tools.md#coordinate-work-across-sessions) over a sliding one-hour window and recursive session creation depth. Set to `off` to remove the limits without changing confirmation or validation requirements. | `"on"` | | `setting(chat.remoteAgentHostsEnabled)` _(Experimental)_
Turn off to prevent this client from connecting to [remote machines for agent sessions](/docs/agents/run/remote-agent-sessions.md) or [cloud sessions](/docs/agents/run/cloud-sandbox-sessions.md). | `true` | | `setting(chat.remoteSessions.tools.enabled)` _(Experimental)_
Provide built-in tools for agents to discover connected remote machines, create and inspect remote sessions, and send messages between sessions. Requires `setting(chat.remoteAgentHostsEnabled)`. Turning this off doesn't disconnect machines or stop remote sessions that are already running. | `false` | | `setting(chat.agentHost.shellTool.initScript.enabled)` `feature(agent-host-shell-initialization)`
Load `~/.bashrc` on macOS and Linux or your PowerShell profiles on Windows before each SDK shell command in local Copilot harness sessions. With [Python Environments](/docs/python/environments.md#terminal-settings) installed and `setting(python-envs.terminal.autoActivationType)` set to `shellStartup`, also activate the selected workspace environment. This does not apply to remote sessions or the Agent Host custom terminal tool. | `false` | | `setting(chat.agents.claude.preferAgentHost)` _(Experimental)_
Run Claude harness sessions opened from the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %} on the Agent Host instead of the GitHub Copilot Chat extension. | `true` | | `setting(chat.editor.codex.preferAgentHost)` _(Experimental)_
Use the Codex harness integration for sessions opened from the {% data variables.copilot.chat_view %} instead of the OpenAI extension. Only one Codex implementation appears per window. Requires `setting(chat.agentHost.codexAgent.enabled)` and prompts for a restart when changed. | `false` | ### {% data variables.copilot.agent_merge_caps %} | Setting and Description | Default | |------------------------|---------------| | `setting(chat.agentMerge.enabled)` _(Experimental)_
Enable [{% data variables.copilot.agent_merge %}](/docs/agents/run/agents-window.md#finish-a-pull-request-with-agent-merge) and its commands. {% data variables.copilot.agent_merge_caps %} monitors a session's pull request and can ask the agent to address selected blockers. | `false` | | `setting(chat.agentMerge.addressReviews)` _(Experimental)_
Address unresolved review threads, changes-requested reviews, and new pull request comments from repository maintainers or the Copilot pull request reviewer. | `true` | | `setting(chat.agentMerge.fixCI)` _(Experimental)_
Ask the agent to fix failed required CI checks. | `true` | | `setting(chat.agentMerge.resolveConflicts)` _(Experimental)_
Ask the agent to update branches that are behind and resolve merge conflicts. | `true` | | `setting(chat.agentMerge.mergePullRequest)` _(Experimental)_
Control whether {% data variables.copilot.agent_merge %} merges or enqueues the pull request when it is ready. `always` merges after any selected maintenance work, `ifUnchanged` merges only until an agent repair turn changes the pull request, and `never` turns off automatic merging. | `"never"` | | `setting(chat.agentMerge.mergeMethod)` _(Experimental)_
Select the merge method. `auto` uses the first repository-compatible method in this order: squash, merge commit, or rebase. You can also require `squash`, `merge`, or `rebase`. | `"auto"` | | `setting(chat.agentMerge.replyAttribution)` _(Experimental)_
Include an automated-reply attribution in review-thread replies posted by {% data variables.copilot.agent_merge %}. | `true` |
